title: Fix products not displaying on product page

requirements.summary: Debug and fix the getAllProducts query in ProductsPage.tsx to successfully fetch and display products from the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Products array is successfully fetched from backend main.mo getAllProducts method
Products are rendered in the grid layout on the products page
Console logs show successful data fetching without errors
Product cards display with correct image, name, price, and add-to-cart functionality

file_operations.description: Add comprehensive debug logging to track the complete data flow from React Query through to component rendering. Log the raw backend response, any data transformations, and the final products array being passed to ProductCard components. Verify the useGetAllProducts hook is correctly invoked and inspect the data structure returned. Check for any filtering or mapping logic that might be hiding products.

Add detailed logging in the useGetAllProducts hook to capture the raw actor response before any transformations. Log the actor instance state, query execution status, and any errors during the fetch operation. Ensure the getAllProducts method is being called correctly on the actor instance and that the response format matches the expected Product[] type from backend.d.ts.

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive error logging to track the complete data flow from backend query through React Query to component rendering
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs show the raw backend response from getAllProducts
Logs capture any data transformation steps in useGetAllProducts hook
Component rendering logs show the final products array being passed to ProductCard components
Error boundaries catch and display any runtime errors during product rendering

file_operations.description: Enhance the useGetAllProducts hook with structured console logging that captures: 1) Actor instance initialization state, 2) Raw response from actor.getAllProducts() before any processing, 3) Data structure validation (check if response is an array, log array length and first item structure), 4) Any transformation or mapping steps applied to the data, 5) Final return value structure. Wrap the query function in try-catch to log any thrown errors with full stack traces.

Add component-level logging to track: 1) Products data received from useGetAllProducts (log the raw data object including isLoading, isError, data fields), 2) Filtered products after search/category filtering is applied (log array length and sample items), 3) Products being mapped to ProductCard components (log each product id/name before rendering), 4) Any conditional rendering logic that might prevent products from displaying. Add console.group/groupEnd for organized debug output.

Add validation logging at the component entry to verify each product prop contains all required fields (id, name, description, price, category, imageUrl). Log any missing or undefined fields that might cause rendering failures. Add error boundary-compatible error handling for malformed product data.

requirements.summary: Ensure the actor instance in useActor.ts is correctly initialized and connected to the deployed backend canister
acceptanceCriteria: Actor instance successfully connects to the backend canister
Canister ID is correctly configured for the deployed environment
Connection errors are caught and logged with actionable messages
Query calls through the actor return valid responses

file_operations.description: Add comprehensive logging and error handling for actor initialization. Log: 1) The canister ID being used for connection, 2) The identity state (authenticated vs anonymous), 3) Actor creation success/failure with detailed error messages, 4) Network configuration and host URL. Add try-catch around actor creation with informative error messages that indicate whether the issue is with canister ID configuration, network connectivity, or authentication state. Verify the actor instance is not null/undefined before returning.

Add actor instance validation before attempting to call getAllProducts. Log the actor object structure to verify it has the getAllProducts method. Add specific error handling for cases where actor is null, undefined, or missing expected methods. Include retry logic with exponential backoff for transient network failures.
